policy: Only explicitly listed action stages consume derived environment channels. The environment remains read-only and deterministic. Unlisted actions are neutral rather than receiving plausible-but-unauthored weather modifiers.
invariants: A channel affects an action only when this file explicitly maps it.
A missing action mapping is mechanically neutral at factor 1000.
The interval profile samples deterministic derived environment across the elapsed action span; no mutable weather state is written.
Environment changes work efficiency only. It never creates a clue, witness statement, mission result, hidden fact, injury, or protected decision.
Travel and combat keep their existing environment consumers and must not receive a second copy of these modifiers.
